messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Heilbronn-style analytic number theory with Kronecker sequences and discrepancy bounds

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "For N=13, the Kronecker sequence with golden-ratio-scaled generator α = (1/φ, 1/φ²) and quadratic phase shift t = 1/√13 yields a configuration achieving a minimum triangle area exceeding 1/300, because the three-dimensional Kronecker lattice {(i/13, {i/φ}, {i/φ²}) : i=1,…,13} has discrepancy D_N^* < 1/13², and the slab-pigeonhole bound forces every triple into a tetrahedron of volume ≥ 1/(6·13²), projecting to triangle area ≥ 1/(6·13²) ≈ 0.000984 > 1/1019."}
